mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, template, style, content, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM resume WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, user_id, title, template, style, content, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM resume
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageLimit} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT id, user_id, title, template, style, content, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM resume WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE

INSERT INTO resume (user_id, title, template, style, content) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{template}, #{style,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{content,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE resume SET template = #{template}, style = #{style,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, content = #{content,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE
